content: मायूर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [मयूर-अण्] .²1 Belonging to or arising from a peacock; मायूरी मदयति मार्जना मनांसि <ls>M. 1. 21</ls>; <ls>Rām. 2. 91. 70</ls>. .²2 Made of the feathers of a peacock. .²3 Drawn by a peacock (as a car). .²4 Dear to a peacock. .{@-रम्@} A flock of peacocks. .{@-री@} <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (अजमोदा).
